history.summary: TOWN CORRECTED: the CSV row says town 'Siwan', but the name 'Maharajganj Temple' refers to a temple in Maharajganj town (notified area in Siwan district, PIN 841238), not Siwan city. No temple under this exact name appears in any source consulted; this file is a clearly-flagged placeholder for a temple in Maharajganj town. Possible intended referents include the town's Shiv Mandir and Rameshwar Dham (26.11782, 84.50579, per Mapcarta/OSM), Garh Devi Temple at Baliya, and a Pashupatinath Temple that one travel site claims was built by Raja Bhoj (uncorroborated by any other source). Coordinates are approximate town coordinates. Identity uncertain - reclassify or replace once Mahesh confirms the intended shrine.

name: Maharajganj Temple
town_description: Maharajganj is a town and notified area in Siwan district, Bihar, near the Uttar Pradesh border (PIN 841238). It is a local market centre with several small temples and shrines.

travel.airport: Patna Airport, the nearest major airport (~160 km); distance approximate
travel.railway: Maharajganj / Duraundha Junction stations nearby; Siwan Junction ~30 km
travel.road: Manjhi-Barauli Road and Maharajganj-Sisai-Goreakothi Road serve the town; local transport in town
